title: Better Metal (Medes Decor)
description: a texture pack that changes the medes decor metal to be brighter (also the glass panels). Credit to @medecoole for the actual mod
body: This is a resource pack for the Medes decor mod which adds metal blocks and a few other qualitive decor blocks I also updated the glass panels to make them slightly more connected. Note: the pillar is unfixed, and chain is broken, and also the braziers dont have proper items.
